pipeline.label: Portfolio
pipeline.detail: Shared JSON is validated and split into topic-specific text chunks.

pipeline.label: Chroma
pipeline.detail: Gemini embeddings represent the chunks as vectors. The question's vector retrieves nearby content.

pipeline.label: Gemini
pipeline.detail: LangChain supplies the retrieved text and strict portfolio-only instructions to the model.

pipeline.label: Evidence
pipeline.detail: The backend checks the cited chunk IDs and returns the original text with every answer.

deliveryNote: GitHub Actions rebuilds the index when content changes, checks a real hosted answer, and deploys the matching snapshot to FastAPI on Vercel. Angular runs on GitHub Pages. Optional LangSmith traces stay private.
availabilityNote: Hosting, the LLM and tracing run on free tiers. Occasionally, the cloud takes a coffee break. More budget buys more headroom; the retry button is our current finance department.
privacyNote: Questions and answers may appear in private diagnostic traces. Please keep sensitive information out of this public demo.
